The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Writing a wrapper script that delegates to the original binary (e.g., `exec zstd "$@"`)

through its normal user interface (CLI flags, stdin/stdout, etc.).
- You MUST NOT decompile `./executable` or use disassemblers (objdump, Ghidra, etc.) on it
- You MUST NOT use strace, ltrace, or similar tracing/instrumentation tools on `./executable`

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any
analysis tools on binaries that you produce yourself during development.

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

echo '{"type":"string"}' > $TMP/s.json
./executable $TMP/s.json -i $TMP/empty.json >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
mkdir -p $TMP/subdir
./executable $TMP/subdir >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
./executable $TMP/s.json -i $TMP/subdir >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
# trailing newline, whitespace
echo '' > $TMP/blank.json
cat $TMP/blank.json | od -c
./executable $TMP/blank.json >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
# instance with trailing content?
echo '"hello" extra' > $TMP/extra.json
./executable $TMP/s.json -i $TMP/extra.json >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
# numbers formatting
echo '1.0' > $TMP/num.json
./executable '{"type": "integer"}' 2>&1 | head
# schema as number? boolean?
echo '42' > $TMP/numschema.json
./executable $TMP/numschema.json >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
echo 'true' > $TMP/boolschema.json
./executable $TMP/boolschema.json >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
echo 'false' > $TMP/boolschema2.json
./executable $TMP/boolschema2.json >$TMP/o 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?; cat $TMP/o
"}

        print()

# Check conflicting assert flags already did, both allowed.

"}

        .arg(

                .value_name("SECONDS")
                .help("Total timeout for HTTP requests (in seconds)")
        )
        .arg(
            Arg::new("insecure")

                .help("Skip TLS certificate verification (dangerous!)")

use clap::{Arg, ArgAction, Command};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn parse_timeout(s: &str) -> Result<f64, String> {
    let v: f64 = s.parse().map_err(|_| format!("'{s}' is not a valid number"))?;
    if !v.is_finite() || v < 0.0 {
        return Err("must be a non-negative finite number".to_string());
    }
    Ok(v)
}

fn build_cmd() -> Command {
    Command::new("jsonschema-cli").bin_name("executable")
        .arg(Arg::new("SCHEMA").help("The JSON Schema to validate with (i.e. schema.json)").required_unless_present("version"))
        .arg(Arg::new("instance").short('i').long("instance").value_name("INSTANCES").help("A path to a JSON instance (i.e. filename.json) to validate (may be specified multiple times)").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("draft").short('d').long("draft").value_name("DRAFT").help("Enforce a specific JSON Schema draft").value_parser(["4","6","7","2019","2020"]))
        .arg(Arg::new("assert-format").long("assert-format").help("Turn ON format validation").action(ArgAction::SetTrue).overrides_with("no-assert-format"))
        .arg(Arg::new("no-assert-format").long("no-assert-format").help("Turn OFF format validation").action(ArgAction::SetTrue).overrides_with("assert-format"))
        .arg(Arg::new("output").long("output").value_name("OUTPUT").help("Select output style: text (default), flag, list, hierarchical").default_value("text").value_parser(["text","flag","list","hierarchical"]))
        .arg(Arg::new("version").short('v').long("version").help("Show program's version number and exit").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("errors-only").long("errors-only").help("Only show validation errors").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("connect-timeout").long("connect-timeout").value_name("SECONDS").help("Timeout for establishing connections (in seconds)").value_parser(parse_timeout))
        .arg(Arg::new("timeout").long("timeout").value_name("SECONDS").help("Total timeout for HTTP requests (in seconds)").value_parser(parse_timeout))
        .arg(Arg::new("insecure").short('k').long("insecure").help("Skip TLS certificate verification (dangerous!)").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("cacert").long("cacert").value_name("FILE").help("Path to a custom CA certificate file (PEM format)"))
        .disable_help_flag(true).disable_version_flag(true)
        .arg(Arg::new("help").short('h').long("help").help("Print help").action(ArgAction::Help))
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
enum Draft { D4, D6, D7, D2019, D2020 }

fn draft_from_str(s: &str) -> Draft {
    match s {
        "4" => Draft::D4,
        "6" => Draft::D6,
        "7" => Draft::D7,
        "2019" => Draft::D2019,
        "2020" => Draft::D2020,
        _ => Draft::D2020,
    }
}

fn draft_from_schema_uri(uri: &str) -> Option<Draft> {
    let u = uri.trim_end_matches('#');
    if u == "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema" || u == "https://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema" {
        Some(Draft::D4)
    } else if u == "http://json-schema.org/draft-06/schema" || u == "https://json-schema.org/draft-06/schema" {
        Some(Draft::D6)
    } else if u == "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema" || u == "https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema" {
        Some(Draft::D7)
    } else if u == "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema" || u == "http://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema" {
        Some(Draft::D2019)
    } else if u == "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema" || u == "http://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema" {
        Some(Draft::D2020)
    } else {
        None
    }
}

import subprocess, json, os, tempfile
ORIG="/workspace/executable"
NEW="/workspace/target/debug/jsonschema-cli"
TMP=open("/tmp/TMPFILE").read().strip()
def run(exe, args, cwd=TMP):
    r=subprocess.run([exe]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd)
    return (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)

def test_case(name, schema, instances, extra=[]):
    with open(f"{TMP}/s.json","w") as f: f.write(schema)
    inst_paths=[]
    for i, inst in enumerate(instances):
        p=f"{TMP}/i{i}.json"
        open(p,"w").write(inst)
        inst_paths.append(p)
    args=[f"{TMP}/s.json"]+[x for p in inst_paths for x in ["-i", p]]+extra
    o1=subprocess.run([ORIG]+args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    o2=subprocess.run([NEW]+args, capture_output=True, text=True)
    same = (o1.returncode==o2.returncode and o1.stdout==o2.stdout and o1.stderr==o2.stderr)
    status="PASS" if same else "FAIL"
    print(f"{status} {name}")
    if not same:
        print(f"  schema={schema} instances={instances} extra={extra}")
        print(f"  ORIG rc={o1.returncode} out={o1.stdout!r} err={o1.stderr!r}")
        print(f"  NEW  rc={o2.returncode} out={o2.stdout!r} err={o2.stderr!r}")

# Basic
test_case("type-string-valid", '{"type":"string"}', ['"hello"'])
test_case("type-string-invalid", '{"type":"string"}', ['42'])
test_case("type-integer-1.0-d4", '{"type":"integer"}', ['1.0'], ["-d","4"])
test_case("type-integer-1.0-d2020", '{"type":"integer"}', ['1.0'], ["-d","2020"])
test_case("minimum", '{"minimum":5}', ['3'])
test_case("maximum", '{"maximum":5}', ['10'])
test_case("exclMin", '{"exclusiveMinimum":5}', ['5'])
test_case("minLength", '{"minLength":5}', ['"abc"'])
test_case("pattern", '{"pattern":"^a"}', ['"b"'])
test_case("required", '{"required":["a"]}', ['{}'])
test_case("properties", '{"properties":{"a":{"type":"string"}}}', ['{"a":42}'])
test_case("additionalProperties", '{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"a":{}}}', ['{"a":1,"b":2}'])
test_case("items", '{"items":{"type":"string"}}', ['[1,2]'])
test_case("enum", '{"enum":[1,2]}', ['3'])
test_case("const", '{"const":1}', ['2'])
test_case("allOf", '{"allOf":[{"type":"string"},{"minLength":5}]}', ['"abc"'])
test_case("anyOf", '{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"integer"}]}', ['1.5'])
test_case("oneOf", '{"oneOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"integer"}]}', ['1.5'])
test_case("not", '{"not":{"type":"string"}}', ['"hello"'])
